# Awesome Social Media Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> A curated list of agent skills for social media: X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn, plus China's Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin, WeChat and Bilibili. From ideas and drafts to images, publishing and analytics. Install them into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Qwen, Doubao or WorkBuddy.

This list collects social media skills for AI agents: writing posts and threads, making covers and short videos, scheduling, tracking trends, replying to comments and reading analytics. Most use the standard SKILL.md format, so any agent that supports skills can install them; see the [FAQ](#faq). Every project was checked by hand and scanned by a script before it was listed, and is sorted by job and platform.

Many projects come from China's creator scene (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat Official Accounts) and are documented in Chinese; the descriptions below are translated.

171 skill projects + 24 MCP tools and open-source platforms · metadata updated 2026-10-19

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompt files (not a standard skill) · 🔌 MCP server or CLI tool · 🧩 full app · 💤 not updated for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

**Let your agent choose**: this list is also a skill. Run `npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-social-media-skills` to install social-media-skill-finder, then ask your agent "I run a LinkedIn account for my startup. Which skill should I use to write posts?"

> [!WARNING]
> Tools that post or reply for you usually log in as you, and some keep your cookies on disk. Read the SKILL.md and scripts before installing to see where your session is stored and where it is sent. Platforms limit automation; bulk posting can get an account throttled or banned.

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked by hand" means the README, directory structure and classification were reviewed; it does not mean the output was tested. The script scan looks for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files, and lists the network addresses in scripts. A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe.

<a id="faq"></a>
## FAQ

### What are the best agent skills for social media?

This list has 171 hand-checked skill projects (data updated 2026-10-19). Start with [All-in-one](#group-pipeline) if you run the whole loop yourself; otherwise go straight to [Writing and content](#group-writing), [Publishing and automation](#group-publish) or [Topics, trends and analytics](#group-research). The [By platform](#by-platforms) index lists every project per platform.

### Which skills work for X, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn?

46 projects target X, 46 YouTube, 31 TikTok and 22 LinkedIn. 12 work on any platform; the most-starred are [humanizer](https://github.com/blader/humanizer), [Humanizer-zh](https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh) and [dbskill](https://github.com/dontbesilent2025/dbskill).

### What is a social media skill, and how is it different from an MCP server?

A skill is a capability pack for an AI agent: a folder built around a `SKILL.md` file, sometimes with scripts and templates. Once installed, the agent follows it for one job, such as writing a LinkedIn post in your voice or turning an article into a thread. An MCP server is a tool that lets the agent read from or post to a platform directly. They are often used together: the skill decides what to write, the MCP server publishes it. MCP servers are listed separately under [MCP servers and CLI tools](#group-mcp) and are not counted as skills.

### Is it safe to let an agent post for me? Can my account get banned?

There are two risks. Your account: automated posting usually logs in as you, and some tools store your cookies on disk, so check where your session is kept and whether it is sent to another server. Platform rules: every platform limits automation, and bulk posting or heavy engagement can get an account throttled or banned. The safe pattern is to let the agent draft and schedule, and click publish yourself.

### What about Chinese platforms like Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin and WeChat?

81 projects target Xiaohongshu, 45 Douyin and 57 WeChat Official Accounts. Most are documented in Chinese; the descriptions here are translated.

### Are these projects safe to install?

Every repo was checked by hand (README, folders and files) and scanned by a script for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files. 171 skill projects and 24 tools and platforms made the list. Repos that were reviewed and turned down are recorded with the reason in [data/ignore.toml](data/ignore.toml) (in Chinese; 19 so far). A normal skill is a few text files and never needs an .exe or .dmg. A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe, so read its `SKILL.md` and scripts before installing.

### How often is the list updated?

Every Monday, stars, last-updated dates and licenses refresh automatically and new repos are searched; new repos are added only after a manual check. See [New this week](#new).

- [awesome-story-skills](https://github.com/UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-story-skills/blob/main/README.en.md): open-source methods for getting LLMs to tell stories, also useful for voice-over scripts and story-driven copy

Suggest a project by [opening an issue](../../issues/new?template=submit-skill.yml), or edit `data/skills.toml` and open a PR; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) (in Chinese; English issues and PRs are welcome). Your own social media skill is welcome too.
